thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] multiple pod restarts detected in ns=prod-serving deployment=tokenize-preproc. 5/12 pods restarting in last 6m, CPU saturation + OOMKilled observed. Some GPU workers downstream reporting CUDA OOMs. Paging on-call.

oncall-bot: Pager: @raj — primary on-call for eng-runtime. Please acknowledge and escalate if needed.

raj: ack — I'm looking.

raj: running quick checks...
```bash
kubectl -n prod-serving get pods | egrep 'tokenize|preproc'
# output: tokenize-preproc-5f7c8   0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   5          4m
tokenize-preproc-6d9ae   0/1     OOMKilled          3          6m
worker-gpu-12           0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   2          3m
```

emma: saw similar burst earlier but smaller — root cause last time was a pathological tokenizer regex. grabbing logs.

emma: logs show repeated regex backtrack in tokenizer parser when processing very long Unicode strings (emoji + ZWJ sequences). stack snippet:
```
RuntimeError: tokenizer parse failure
  File "/app/tokenizer/parser.py", line 412, in tokenize
    tokens = complex_split(pattern, text)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/re.py", line 234, in split
    raise re.error('catastrophic backtracking')
MemoryError
```

kai: that's consistent with the memory spike. these preproc pods are CPU-only and hit memory blowout, node OOM kills them and that pushes more load downstream to GPU workers which then hit CUDA OOM when oversized batches arrive.

maria: customer-impact: alerting shows 5xx rate up ~7% global over last 10m, top-impacted tenant = AcmeCorp (15% 5xx). Support ticket incremented.

support-bot: Created ticket #12345 for AcmeCorp — assigned to @maria.

raj: mitigation plan — short term to stop customer impact: 1) apply emergency ingress rate-limit for tokenize route 2) scale out preproc nodes (add 4 CPU nodes) 3) cordon+drain the most noisy nodes 4) push quick tokenizer guard that rejects extremely long contiguous emoji sequences 5) rollback last tokenizer deploy if necessary. executing now.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered for patch branch: tokenizer-guard-shortcircuit (PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/tokenizer/pull/842)

raj: applied ingress rate limit via edge admin API (reducing per-tenant concurrency to 25):
```http
POST /internal/admin/ratelimit
{ "route": "/v1/generate/tokenize", "concurrency": 25, "scope": "tenant" }
```

kai: starting nodepool scale-up (k8s autoscaler + manual bump): 
```bash
# increase nodepool to +4 nodes
cloudctl nodepool patch us-west-2-prod-tokenize --size +4
```

emma: rolling a canary with the tokenizer patch (guard) to 2 pods now. will monitor.

raj: cordoning noisy node node-3a (high oom events)
```bash
kubectl cordon node-3a && kubectl drain node-3a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

emma: canary logs show the guard short-circuits the long emoji tokenization and returns 413 for >10k contiguous unicode chars. CPU usage on canary halved immediately.

maria: support update posted to AcmeCorp — we reduced request concurrency and are rolling a fix to tokenizer. asked for any degraded functionality reports.

support-bot: Customer AcmeCorp updated in ticket #12345 (status: mitigation in progress).

raj: small follow-up — downstream GPU worker errors dropped after ingress rate limiting and scaling. we still see a few CUDA OOMs from earlier bad batches, but they are recovery restarts now.

kai: applied hotfix to HPA to cap burst concurrency on preprocessors. also enabled prefix cache for 30m TTL to cut repeated identical prefixes.

emma: rolling full rollout of tokenizer-guard patch (v2.1.3) to remaining replicas. will pause if we see error regression.

deploy-bot: rollout 2/10 -> 5/10 -> 10/10 completed.

raj: monitoring: 5xx rate dropped back to baseline ~1.1%. AcmeCorp 5xx down to 2.4%. CPU usage on preproc pool gradually normalizing.

sre_jules: taking over on-call for next shift — @raj please handoff. what needs follow-up: 1) postmortem to confirm root cause (regex pathological backtracking / unbounded token length) 2) add mitigation in parser to bound token loop 3) add tests with long emoji sequences 4) tune OOM kill thresholds on nodepool.

raj: handing off to @sre_jules — notes: PR 842 contains short-circuit + unit tests, issued rollback not necessary, autoscaler scaled nodes to +4 temporarily and will scale down when idle. follow-up owner for postmortem: @emma + @kai.

maria: I'll draft customer communication for impacted tenants and share in #customer-status.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2077 created (severity=sev2) — status: mitigated -> monitoring.

sre_jules: closing thread here, will open postmortem doc and link. please add any missing action items. :thumbsup:

emma: adding action: add real-time regex watch in observability to catch heavy backtracking patterns and alert before OOM.

support-bot: Ticket #12345 updated (mitigated).

maria: thanks team. handoff complete.
